content_units: Saturday Dinner Fit for 4 in Melbourne

For a   vegetarian dinner for 4 at around 19:00   with a   pre-drinks budget of AUD 140  , the best overall pick is   Lentil Lane  . It matches the dietary need most strongly, stays comfortably within budget, and offers the quietest setting for an evening meal.
Ranked Restaurant Comparison
Rank   Restaurant   Cuisine Variety   Vegetarian Friendliness   Noise Level   Estimated Cost for 4   Budget Fit   Verdict
1   Lentil Lane   Focused vegetarian menu   Excellent   Quiet     AUD 72-96     Excellent   Best overall
2   Spice Courtyard   Strong Indian variety   Very good   Moderate     AUD 68-112     Excellent   Best alternative
3   Noodle Mint   Good Asian fusion range   Good   Moderate     AUD 64-88     Excellent   Good value, weaker for planning
4   Grill House Central   Limited for vegetarians   Poor   Loud     AUD 110-116   for vegetarian mains only   Tight   Not suitable
Best Pick: Lentil Lane
Option 1:   Lentil Lane     Fully vegetarian, quiet, and comfortably under budget for 4     Best fit for vegetarian dinner
- Expected spend:   AUD 72-96 total   for 4 mains.
- Best for your priorities: strongest vegetarian friendliness, easiest budget fit, and lowest noise.
- Saturday at 19:00 is a prime slot, and   bookings are recommended  , which makes it more dependable than walk-in-only options.
Find venue
Why the Others Rank Lower
Option 2:   Spice Courtyard     Broad Indian menu with many vegetarian dishes     Best backup for variety
- Likely the best choice if your group wants   more cuisine variety and sharing-style options  .
- Budget still works well at   AUD 68-112   for 4 mains.
- Ranked below Lentil Lane because it is only   moderately quiet   and not fully vegetarian.
Option 3:   Noodle Mint     Good-value casual Asian fusion with 5 vegetarian mains     Best low-cost casual option
- Great on price at   AUD 64-88   for 4 mains.
- Lower rank because   no reservations   is a drawback for   Saturday 19:00  , when Melbourne casual spots can be busy.
- Vegetarian selection is decent, but less dedicated than Lentil Lane.
Option 4:   Grill House Central     Steakhouse with only 2 vegetarian mains     Trade-off option only
- It technically fits the budget for 4 vegetarian mains at   AUD 110-116  , but only just once sides or extras are added.
- Loud atmosphere plus very limited vegetarian choice makes it the weakest match.
Dining Context for This Pick
Using your priorities in order, the weighting is effectively:
-   Vegetarian friendliness  : most important
-   Value within AUD 140  : must-have
-   Noise level  : important for a comfortable dinner
-   Cuisine variety  : useful, but after the above
On that basis,   Lentil Lane   wins because it avoids the main risks:
- no weak vegetarian selection
- no budget pressure
- no loud setting
- no Saturday walk-in uncertainty if you book ahead
